# Honest Weight Loss Reviews

> Independent reviews of behaviour-change weight-loss apps and meal plans for adults in the United States (18+). No promises about results, no testimonials, no invented figures. Every price and trial term is checked against official pages or labelled "To be verified".

## Site

- [Home](https://wlreviews.github.io/)
- [About and disclosure](https://wlreviews.github.io/about.html)

## Articles

- [WeightWatchers vs Noom: an honest comparison](https://wlreviews.github.io/ww-vs-noom.html) — Hub comparison. Outline published 2026-11-20; full text to follow after the buyer persona and keyword checks. Prices and trial terms to be verified.

## Planned articles

- Noom pricing and free trial, checked
- Noom vs MyFitnessPal: behaviour change or calorie tracking?
- Can you use Noom without exercising?
- WeightWatchers vs MyFitnessPal: points or free tracking?

## Method

- Each comparison covers three options, judged on the same five points: price and trial terms, daily use, coaching and support, food tracking, cancelling.
- No star ratings. No weight-loss promises. Affiliate disclosure on every page. Adults 18+ only.
